text:
RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 35

The all-male panel is weak evidence by itself. In bank risk functions, senior panels are male-dominated as a matter of base rates, so an all-male panel is roughly what you'd expect even where the process was clean. It becomes meaningful only alongside other facts.

Your stronger points are substantive: you were assessed as more qualified on paper, and the stated rationale ("broad experience of regulatory affairs") is vague. Note, though, that regulatory engagement is genuinely central to a head-of-risk role, so that reason may be real rather than pretextual.

The clearest issue is the ignored request. Chase it in writing, cite any applicable disclosure right, and ask for scoring against the published criteria. Decide after you see their reasoning.
